svg.text: SciFi: scientific manuscripts from findings to inference
One repo, three ways to run it (Claude Code plugin, plain .claude/ folder, claude.ai skills). Three actors. Every handoff is a JSON file in the workspace.
the standards: global, sections, figures, journals, checklist
central claim, gap, results, threads of evidence
reverse outline per section from the threads
the paragraph loop: map, 5 checks, draft, gate
Zotero MCP or Better BibTeX export, evidence lookup
sonnet, medium previous and next paragraph
sonnet, medium claims vs sources and results
inherit: one pass, PASS or RETURN
inherit: applies accepted comments as diffs
what a user folder looks like (right column)
the 28 paper analyses behind the standards
Types a command or a phrase:
"draft the discussion", "check my intro" phrases route too
Decides at gates: picks an option, approves diffs, answers NEED: requests.
Owns Manuscript/ and Literature/. The system never edits them.
threads of evidence to an outline: skeleton.json
dispatch, read envelopes, decide, draft, gate
section and whole gates, comments.json, improve
Small active memory: STATE.json, the current unit's logic.json, envelope summaries.
Paragraph loop, per unit (checks run in parallel):
claims, evidence, steps of the text: logic.json
internal: one point, old to new, first and last sentence
previous and next paragraph: overlap, placement, bridge
spine and results: serves the claim, same gap, no new data
each claim vs cited source, our results, or a logical step
rewrites from logic.json and accepted findings (your model)
one pass against the standards: PASS or RETURN
Each returns a JSON envelope file. Never edits Manuscript/. Never invents sources (NEED:).
options + one pick at each gate
Better CSL JSON with citation keys
where we are, next action, mode, journal
outline per section, thread per paragraph
claims, evidence, steps of one paragraph
read first; rewritten by the ritual
Human owns Manuscript/ and Literature/ (read-only to the system).
Master owns Thinking-space/ and is the only writer of shared files.
Sub-agents write only their own envelope and unit files.
A hook validates every JSON on write; a malformed envelope is rejected.
Resume = read STATE.json, then the tail of log/decisions.jsonl.
Accepted work is never redrafted; human edits never overwritten.

Model routing: sonnet at medium effort for every checker and mapper (independent, parallel, cheap); sonnet at low effort for lookups and the script-backed style pass; your session model (Opus or Fable) for the drafter, the gate and the improver, where judgement and prose matter.
